D01.user_path: A new per-row Edit Saved Area affordance targets the row directly. Existing label/select_roi behavior stays unchanged. The new action never calls native select(), never replaces current/previous global selection, and never disables linked viewing.
D01.entry_callback: Window::beginSavedRoiGeometryEdit(row_index) validates one admitted saved area/native owner and resource metadata, focuses only that row, navigates each explicitly constrained t/c/z once (wildcards retain current values), then captures the native active-owner context. Navigation is a separate Display effect observed before edit capture.
D01.target_and_visibility: Show Saved area, owner, one-based row/name and exact T/C/Z constraints (* wildcard; explicit0 displayed as1). Indices/positions remain zero-based in core/records. Editing does not modify name/t/c/z/row attributes. No durable ROI UUID or new session field.
D01.private_geometry: Construct existing SelectionEditor from captured row.selection, shape and calibrated XY metric. Draft/handles/vertex focus stay separate from global selection/creation editors. Only original XY and linked XY accept input; XZ/YZ remain read-only. Do not use d->frame()/legacy State/global selection as geometry source.
D01.geometry_scope: Retain all entry area kinds: rectangle, ellipse, rotated_rectangle, rotated_ellipse, polygon, freehand and mask. Reuse box local axes/handle indices, metric hit testing, Shift/Ctrl edit modifiers and Shift15degree rotation. Polygon/freehand vertex insert/delete/nudge uses existing native rules. Mask move/rotate retains packed holes; no invented mask resize/vertices.
D01.attributes: This child changes geometry only. Replacement width and complete selection attributes must equal original; row name/optionalTCZ/row attributes and all other rows remain identical. Existing recognized style and opaque/future attributes are preserved. New saved-row style editing remains an explicit later consumer, not silently enabled by the adapter.
D01.accept: A valid changed pointer preview accepts on release using the LAST delivered drag, without regrowing from release coordinates. Numeric Apply accepts the current valid draft. One complete acceptance ends/releases that private draft; manager focus remains on the accepted row and another edit captures a fresh context.
D01.invalid_cancel_noop: Partial/nonfinite/invalid numeric input disables Apply and clears publishable preview, preserving raw text for correction. Invalid transform/exception/Escape/Cancel clears the entire active gesture; later release cannot resurrect old valid geometry. Exact unchanged geometry publishes no transaction and appends no workflow. Empty native masks remain valid and have no handles; unchanged transforms are no-op.
D01.manager_reselection: Stage new singleton focus/index/expected complete accepted row before publication. After changed commit install manager focus by no-throw swap at the new Metadata revision, clearing old multiselection/range anchors; never call native select. Undo/redo always invalidates capture, then preserves index only if exact expected restored Roi is known/present, otherwise clears focus. Any unrelated Metadata/owner/reorder/delete/load clears old row tokens.
D01.rendering: During valid private preview substitute only the targeted saved-row drawing, not native metadata; avoid drawing its old outline plus draft twice. Current global selection/other rows remain visible per existing policy. After commit/undo/redo, observe current committed generation in linked panes; XY outline changes, XZ/YZ raw pixels/calibration/crosshair/channel mapping stay exact. No XY ROI projection into XZ/YZ is claimed.

public_types.SavedRoiGeometryRequest: Explicit constructor(row_index:size_t,replacement:Selection); no default row or implicit borrowed replacement.
public_types.ResolvedSavedRoiGeometryCommand: Immutable owned source snapshot, exact original Roi/index, replacement Selection and normalized record. Const C++ getters; Python returns detached values. No raw mutable owner/selection borrow.
public_types.SavedRoiGeometryCapture: Opaque Application-minted active-owner/activation capture with source Data identity/revisions and TCZ. Capture is not constructible from numeric IDs and never serialized.
public_types.PreparedSavedRoiGeometryEdit: Move-only staged transaction/normalized record/resource lease plus original capture. No native mutation in preparation.
public_types.SavedRoiGeometryPublication: Small no-throw result {document_id:uint64,changed:bool}; snapshots/getter copies are separate post-operation calls, not a fallible publication result constructor.

Window/public desktop apply_saved_roi_geometry(request), replay_saved_roi_geometry(record,complete_rebind_request=nullopt): thin guarded capture/prepare/publish entry, returns detached normalized record/publication information staged before mutation
D02.capture_and_prepare: Fresh resolve requires admitted area row visible at captured TCZ and creates a command bound to that exact owner/Data/row. Capture must precede callbacks/gesture lifetime; preparation cannot mint a new activation token after an away/back event. A command may refresh Display-only source state while retaining the same owner/Data/TCZ; pointer command source records actual mouse-down Display revision/transform. All caller-owned values/control/limits/records are captured before callbacks.
D02.atomic_lane: Under Application membership mutex check exact retained owner pointer plus numeric ID, current active owner and SAME captured activation_identity_. Under the same operation acquire Document mutex and check captured Data(Pixels/Metadata/Selection), shape/type/policy, exact row/index equality and current TCZ. Check optional Pointer Display revision too. Only then enter existing transaction commit machinery. App membership->Document is existing lock order. No user callback or unlock/check/relock window between final checks and mutation.
D02.minimal_document_change: Root adds a narrow private Document::commit_saved_roi_geometry_guarded transaction adapter, or an optional internal saved-row guard consumed INSIDE the existing commit_impl lock. It checks expected Data/row/position before mutation and preserves fresh Display. Do not implement the TCZ check in Window followed by ordinary Application.commit, introduce a generic validation callback under locks, new Document revision or serialized epoch.
D02.camera_and_position_rules: Numeric publication permits fresh camera/pan/XY-crosshair/unrelated Display state while current TCZ remains equal. Pointer publication additionally requires mouse-down Display revision unchanged (conservative cancellation on any Display change during the drag) and the same captured XY transform; never reinterpret screen coordinates. UI TCZ actions cancel the draft before changing position. Native atomic guard is current-TCZ equality, not a TCZ-event-history epoch: a direct headless position roundtrip ending at the original TCZ is allowed if Data/activation still match; no hidden navigation-history guarantee is claimed. Owner away/back always stales through the existing activation token.
D02.busy_rule: Shared UI disables entry/Apply and cancels private draft on its actual busy transition. No new generic core prohibition on unrelated pending work: normal source revision guards cause conflicting queued operations to refuse.
D02.no_read_and_admission: Metadata-only; all supported valid native Dataset type/sample layouts may preserve pixels without acquiring any plane/strip/window. First physical fixtures use admitted scientific U16/F32/U8 views. No new desktop viewer/type/legacy export admission is implied. Full original record structural/bounds validation precedes owner lookup/rebind; callbacks never run under owner locks.

record.source_types: id/revisions strict uint64 integers, shape6 strictly positive supportedTCZYXS integers, type exactly uint8|uint16|float32|float64, sample_policy exactly finite_only|preserve_quiet_nan_float32 under existing valid Dataset rules; reject bool/lossy/overflow/unknown enums. selection_revision is provenance for strict replay, not a historical dependency. roi_count is a strict positive size_t-compatible integer, equal to the captured saved-row count; checked count/row-storage arithmetic must fit limits without allocating by that untrusted claim.
record.position_types: Strict zero-based nonbool bounded ints in original shape. Fresh record position must satisfy original optional Roi position constraints.
record.original_roi: Complete canonical NativeV3 Roi representation at held session source pin (name, selection, explicit nullable t/c/z, attributes). No stripping or separate ROI format. index strict nonbool size_t-compatible and strictly less than source.roi_count; row identity is transient index+Metadata+complete value, not UUID.
record.replacement: Complete canonical NativeV3 Selection using the existing variant grammar at held session/selection pins. Reuse/extract its encoder and bounded strict parser; do not invent a second points/style/mask schema. Exact known variant keys/numbers/packed lengths/tail bits validated; unknown semantic attributes remain opaque/preserved. Original/result selection must be admitted areas and width/attributes exactly unchanged. No authenticated pointer/drag-equation claim.
record.unknown_fields: Reject unknown top/source/position/original/Roi/known Selection variant fields and malformed null/enum/numeric alternatives; preserve opaque attribute subtrees under existing NativeV3 policy. NativeV3 always encodes t/c/z keys, null wildcard and explicit0 distinctly.

D02.strict_replay: Validate whole record first, then bind original owner plus original Pixels/Metadata, shape/type/policy, row/index and complete original Roi. Preserve current global current/previous selection and current navigation. Build replay command against a FRESH capture of current Selection/activation/TCZ, retaining original record source.selection_revision/position as provenance. Historical Selection/Display need not match; any further Data/TCZ/activation change during preparation/publication refuses. A successful saved-row write advances Metadata, so the same record replayed again is stale. Historical saved-position visibility is not reimposed on fresh navigation: replay can edit the bound row while viewing another TCZ. Fresh TCZ is a publication guard only; fresh interactive resolve/full rebind still requires explicit visible-row capture. Verify actual saved-row count equals record source.roi_count before binding; no record-only cardinality claim is trusted as allocation authority.
D02.full_rebind: Validate the complete old record BEFORE replacement parsing/owner lookup. Require explicit new row_index AND complete replacement Selection. Resolve against new owner/row/current-position capture; copy no old row/index/position/result by default. Reopened owner identity always requires this route.
D02.history_recording: Changed row updates native Metadata+Selection exactly once, one undo/redo-clear/dirty data identity advance, Pixels/Display unchanged. Preserve current+previous global selections. Exact no-op creates no transaction/history/dirty/record. Window preallocates exact record append/focus/output/status before native publication, appends only after changed success and without allocation/callbacks. Recording off alters append only. On failure native/document/workflow/history remain unchanged; invalid private captures release.
D02.publication_staging: The normalized record is owned by command/prepared handles before publish; Window reserves workflow capacity, manager focus and success diagnostic payload before entering native publish. The publication return contains only document_id/changed. Post-publication adapter work is no-throw installation; getter copies are separate optional queries and cannot masquerade as failure of an already committed action.

D03.membership_policy: The following named memberships are proposed frozen at root adoption, not executions. Each surface declares exact collected IDs before its first gate. Assertions may share test-owned pure transport helpers, but expected geometry/membership never comes from SelectionEditor, product processing or producer output. No new ImageJ reference capture is prerequisite for this owned workflow; reuse of unchanged geometry is source-identity scoped, not upstream pointer/OS parity.

Snapshot every exact actual value before capture; setup grants no physical-input credit.

resource_estimate.rule: A documented conservative logical native working estimate, not process RSS. Every addition/multiplication/count conversion checked before allocation. Validate dimensions, area kind, packed lengths/tail bits, depth, row_count/index and metadata cardinalities before cloning/callbacks. No plane/strip/window acquisition at any phase.

symbols.N: checked source XY area; independent of TCZ volume and channel/sample count
symbols.D: owned nonpixel source/transaction data and display payload: metadata/calibration strings, current+previous selections, overlay/spectrum storage, scalar containers and descriptors; exclude saved-row vector counted separately and retained immutable source pixel buffers
symbols.R: complete saved-row vector storage and recursive name/Selection/attributes owned bytes, including every row because existing set_rois/transaction may copy the collection
symbols.So_Sn: complete original/replacement Selection values, point vectors, strings, attributes, packed bytes and descriptors
symbols.C: typed normalized command-record owned metadata storage upper bound obtained by structural traversal before materialization
symbols.W: conservative normalized wire bytes: checked punctuation/key/scalar bounds and escaped string bound<=6*UTF8_bytes; no unbounded formatter to discover size; W<=max_record_bytes
symbols.H: sizeof all live snapshot/capture/request/limits/control/prepared/transaction/history/manager-focus/record holders and fixed geometry scratch; count shared-payload owner/control holders without charging retained pixel volume as new allocation

resource_estimate.working_bytes_upper_bound: 16KiB +4*D +4*R +6*So +6*Sn +3*C +3*W +H +2*(V+16)*sizeof(SelectionHandle) + (mask_operation ? 2*N*sizeof(double) : 0). The deliberately conservative multiplicities cover simultaneously live capture/editor/command/transaction/history/workflow staging. The implementation documents any tightened exact liveness sum before its first gate; it may not omit a whole copied collection or hidden record copy.
resource_estimate.limits: Use D02 limits and effective UI cap=min(native max_working_bytes, configured nonzero processing_memory_mb converted with checked arithmetic). Large native shapes can be rejected under the cap; max_xy_pixels is admission ceiling, not a promise that every admitted mask fits max_working_bytes.
resource_estimate.controlled_geometry_required_change: The pinned SelectionEditor API currently has NO ExecutionControl parameters. Add narrow opt-in controlled construction/moved/rotated mask overloads or an equivalent private adapter that polls before allocations and at bounded raster/vertex stages. Preserve existing uncontrolled signatures and exact qualified geometry. No callbacks under owner locks, no new geometry algorithm/job framework, and no assertion that nonexistent old hooks already cover cancellation.
resource_estimate.callbacks: Deterministic malformed/limit/overflow and valid precancel refusal precede user callbacks. Capture source/request/control/limits before the first checkpoint. Bounded kernel checkpoints/stage reports may throw or cancel before commit; initial callback reentry must not change captured caller values. No callback between final guard and publication. UI clears canceled/failed draft leases; active retained count/bytes become zero.
resource_estimate.external: Allocator bookkeeping/opaque std::function target internals, Python/getter representation copies, provider caches, rendering/GPU storage and process RSS remain external to this native logical estimate; no latency, heap or benchmark pass is claimed.

compatibility_and_exit.reuse: Keep the unchanged SelectionEditor/session/targets/native commit source pins from source-revalidation.json. Controlled overloads invalidate only their directly affected native geometry/cancel compatibility tests.

Then thin Python API, fresh installed public-only SDK, host tests, both20 actual-input observations, exact independent reader, affected regressions, and final matching archive/license/manifest binding. Broad regressions/final products run after source settles, not after every small patch.
compatibility_and_exit.closure: Scoped saved-row scientific XY is complete only when native/Python/SDK/host/both shared ImGui assertions bind exact final installed products, source, fixture, record, session and commercial provenance. Family/whole-editor acceptance remains unchanged. Read-only XZ/YZ projection, XZ/YZ edits, positioned creation, saved-row style editing, full ROI-manager/ZIP and axis remapping remain required follow-ons.
